Products and the line. Component makers optimise their box and warrant it at their flange. We design the products to work as one line and are accountable for the system within the agreed scope and acceptance criteria. Both are needed. Only one of them looks at the whole thermal path.

Prefabricated liquid cooling for AI data centres: we plan and design the system, deliver skids, CDUs, ORv3 racks and cooling plant, and test, commission and maintain the liquid loop in the field. Every boundary comes with its evidence.
